title: Localization Hom and multiplication tower criterion
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site with small underlying category, let $U$ be an object of $\mathcal C$, let $f\in\mathcal O(U)$, and let $K\in D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. On the slice site $\mathcal C/U$, let $T(K|_U,f)$ be a derived inverse limit [def-weil-derived-limit] in $D(\mathcal O_U)$ of the tower $\cdots\xrightarrow{f}K|_U\xrightarrow{f}K|_U$ whose transition maps are multiplication by $f$ [def-weil-inverse-system]. Then $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal O_U[1/f],K|_U)=0$ if and only if $T(K|_U,f)=0$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

source.place: Tag 0997 (lemma-hom-from-Af), especially the equivalence of (1) and (3) via the free resolution of $\mathcal O_f$ and the derived multiplication tower.

proof.text: On the slice site put L=K|_U. Use the canonical telescope short exact sequence 0→P→P→O_U[1/f]→0, whose maps and endpoint are the actual sequential-colimit localization in the statement [lem-weil-pbc-local-coefficient-telescope]. The single-complex functor is exact, so Mathlib DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished supplies its distinguished triangle.

source.place: Tag 0997, proof of lemma-hom-from-Af, equivalence (1) and (3).

proof.text: Apply the contravariant triangulated functor RHom(-,L) from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction] to the opposite triangle. Mathlib Triangle.isZero₁_iff_isIso₂ says that its first object RHom(O_U[1/f],L) is zero precisely when precomposition with the telescope map is an isomorphism. The shift structure is the opposite triangulated structure, so no extra rotation is needed.

source.place: Tag 0997, proof of lemma-hom-from-Af, equivalence (1) and (3).

proof.text: The comparison [lem-weil-pbc-local-coefficient-free-derived-hom-product] identifies RHom(P[0],L) with the product of the copies of L and intertwines the dual telescope map with the tower transition endomorphism 1-shift. Thus the two endomorphisms are conjugate and are invertible simultaneously.

source.place: Tag 0997, proof of lemma-hom-from-Af, equivalence (1) and (3).

proof.text: Unpack the given IsDerivedLimit witness [def-weil-derived-limit]. Its triangle has first object T and second arrow the same tower transition endomorphism. Applying Triangle.isZero₁_iff_isIso₂ to this distinguished triangle gives the converse zero criterion. Compose the two equivalences. No existence or uniqueness result for derived limits is required.
